findings.text: The regex $CONTROL_CHAR\[[0-9;]+m does not match ANSI sequences with non-digit characters like \033[?25h or zero-parameter codes like \033[m, leaving ESC characters unescaped in XML output; input '\033[m' produces invalid XML with a raw ESC byte.
The regex only matches SGR color codes (ending in 'm'), missing other ANSI sequences like cursor movement \033[2J or \033[K, leaving ESC characters unescaped and producing invalid XML.
